title: Implement SQLite-backed LogStorage using sqlx
description:
Implement SqliteLogStorage: SQLite-backed implementation of LogStorage using sqlx. Tables: `log_entries(id BLOB PK, group_name TEXT, hlc_timestamp BLOB, article_cid BLOB, operator_signature BLOB)`, `log_entry_parents(entry_id BLOB, parent_id BLOB)`, `group_tips(group_name TEXT, tip_id BLOB)`. All SQL in this module, nowhere else. Migrations in core/migrations/. Artifact: core/src/group_log/sqlite_storage.rs, core/migrations/.

Acceptance: all shared tests from C pass against SQLite implementation; migration runs on fresh database; migration is idempotent (running twice is safe); no SQL outside this module
